title: Digital Media Buyer - Remote, Latin America
description:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for someone with a strong media and advertising foundation; well versed in Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Ads, Google Campaign Manager, planning, presenting, executing, and optimizing all media strategies.

Our ideal candidate thrives on data and is adept at using it to craft the highest performing campaigns possible. We’re seeking someone who is well organized, attentive to detail, and most importantly is as passionate as the rest of our team is about driving results overnight and building stronger brands over time. Above all, we think having the right positive, engaged personality is crucial for our work culture and to create a passionate tie to our agency’s thriving team philosophy.


Media Buying & Strategy
  • Execute data-driven media buying strategies that align with client goals and target audiences.
  • Conduct market research to identify the most effective media channels.
  • Analyze historical campaign data to inform media mix and performance projections.
  • Recommend channel-specific budgets and optimize spend based on performance metrics.
  • Stay current on media trends, platform updates, and emerging technologies, including AI and automation tools.
Campaign Execution & Management
  • Launch, manage, and optimize paid media campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, and programmatic display.
  • Monitor real-time campaign performance and proactively adjust bids, budgets, and targeting to improve efficiency and results.
  • Track key KPIs such as leads, cost per acquisition (CPA), cost per lead (CPL), engagement rates, web traffic, and form fills.
Budget Management
  • Manage and allocate media budgets effectively across channels to maximize campaign performance.
  • Maintain daily, weekly, and monthly budget pacing and ensure campaigns remain on schedule and within financial targets.
  • Identify opportunities for cost-saving without compromising campaign effectiveness.
Skills & Qualifications
  • 3+ years of experience in media buying, preferably in an agency setting or with companies providing B2B services/recruiting to software development firms.
  • Strong experience in paid media platforms (Google Ads, Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Ads, programmatic platforms).
  • Proven track record of managing performance marketing campaigns with a focus on results.
  • Proficiency in analytics and attribution tools (Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, third-party trackers, etc.)
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Proficiency with media buying and planning tools.
Company Benefits
  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

The ideal candidate will be detail oriented problem solver and team player who is passionate about the opportunity to partner with sales teams, is also passionate about our role in the technology industry bringing open source to a wider audience of innovators and enterprises, and will support the delivery of programs to enable Canonical's continued success.

The role entails:

  • Support all aspects of the day-to-day operations of the sales function globally
  • Check opportunities for accuracy and provision orders on successful closure of a deal
  • Support the Sales Operations Analysts and Manager to report on and improve sales data quality and processes
  • Support the sales team globally on CRM and other sales operations systems
  • Deliver sales metrics, dashboards and other ad-hoc analytical tasks
  • Assist the team with automation and streamlining of the Lead to Order process
What we are looking for in you:
  • An exceptional academic track record from high school and university
  • Experience working in an entry-level role in sales operations or related (e.g. financial analysis, sales analysis or sales order processing), preferably in the technology industry
  • Energetic, thoughtful, systematic approach, focused on robust, repeatable and scalable outcomes
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to work productively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization on a global scale
  • Ability to work across team boundaries and communicate effectively
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
What Canonical offers
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. title: Salesforce Data Migration Specialist
description:
About Us :

Kelley Austin takes a different approach to Salesforce Consulting by putting our employees first. That’s not hyperbole, either. Our team takes a proactive approach to employee satisfaction by having every single person fill out a “happiness list,” which comprises the top ten things each employee finds happiness in outside of work.

We review those happiness lists regularly to ensure everyone is checking most of the boxes and adjust their project load, responsibilities, or schedule accordingly if not.

Look at our benefits and perks below to learn more about our culture.

We’re growing fast (more than doubling YOY) but staying diligent in hiring the best possible people who don’t just want a job, but will actually care about the success of their co-workers and clients.

Our growth, coupled with the distinction of being recognized as the 'fastest Salesforce Implementation Partner to achieve Platinum / Summit status,' attests to the success of our approach.

Take a look at the ‘About You’ and ‘Responsibilities’ below to learn more :

Benefits

  • Base Salary
  • Work From Home Flexibility
  • Flexible PTO (we treat people like adults here)
  • Paid Holidays (including an entire week off around Christmas and New Year)

Tools We Use

  • As a technology software consulting company, we use many tools, but the big four are Google Drive, Slack, Lucid Chart, and Salesforce, of course.

Perks Of The Job

  • You won’t really find egos here. We hire slowly and purposefully to keep our culture strong and our team cohesive.
  • We don’t say yes to every client and are not afraid to part ways with a client, either. If there’s no mutual respect or success involved, we politely decline and help them find a different partner. That means fewer ‘tough’ clients and more clients who “get it” and work harmoniously together.
  • We offer half a dozen different clubs like book club, health club, movie club, hobby club, and more. These bring people together to grow intellectually and get to know one another outside of project work.
  • We work an average of 40 hours per week (I know, that’s unheard of in consulting, but we stand by it).

About You

We are seeking a Data Migration Specialist with deep hands-on expertise in Salesforce, Salesforce SOQL, Salesforce APEX, relational databases, SQL, scripting, and large-scale data migration. This role is highly execution-focused and detail-oriented — you will be designing and running ETL processes, writing queries and scripts, validating data quality, and ensuring successful end-to-end migrations between enterprise systems.

Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and manage end-to-end data migration projects, including extraction, transformation, loading, and validation.
  • Write and optimize complex SQL and SOQL queries for data validation, migration, and reconciliation.
  • Build, configure, and run ETL jobs to move and transform data across Salesforce, ERP, and external databases.
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts (APEX, Python, Shell, PowerShell, or similar) for data processing, cleansing, and quality checks.
  • Perform data profiling, mapping, and transformation to meet business and technical requirements.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve migration issues such as data mismatches, performance bottlenecks, and integrity errors.
  • Collaborate with internal and external Salesforce, integration, and business teams to coordinate cutovers and validate migrated data.
  • Document migration procedures, scripts, mappings, and reconciliation steps for repeatability and compliance.
  • Ensure all migrations follow best practices for data quality, security, and governance.

Required Technical and Professional Expertise

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent hands-on experience).
  • 5+ years of direct experience in data migration, ETL, or database engineering roles.
  • Strong technical expertise in relational databases (Salesforce, Oracle, SQL Server, or similar).
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL (query optimization, joins, stored procedures).
  • Practical experience with Salesforce SOQL, APEX, and Salesforce data model.
  • Proven track record in data migration projects, including reconciliation and cutover planning.
  • Hands-on scripting skills in Python, Shell, PowerShell, or similar.
  • Familiarity with ETL tools, APIs, and bulk data processing.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is a plus.
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to deliver under tight deadlines.

NOTE : Kelley Austin will not be able to sponsor applicants for work visas.

Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.
Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!
Responsibilities and assignments
O Cientista de Dados aplica uma sólida expertise em intelicência artificial por meio do uso de machine learning, data mining e recuperação de informações para desenhar, criar protótipos e desenvolver mecanismos e serviços de advanced analytics. O cientista de dados colabora com os parceiros de negócios para definição do problema técnico e a hipótese a ser testada: desenvolve modelos analíticos eficientes e precisos que imitam as decisões de negócios e as incorporam a produtos ou ferramentas de dados analíticos com o suporte de uma equipe multifuncional.
O que esperamos que você realize:

  • Colaborar com parceiros de negócios para desenvolver novas formas de atingir os objetivos utilizando técnions e ferramentas de ponta.
  • Comunicar eficazmente a abordagem de analytios e como ela atenderá e abordará os objetivos aos parceiros de negócio
  • Educar sobre o valor da tomada de decisão basesda em dados, focando no "como e por que" da rezolução de problemas
  • Liderar abordagens analiticas, integrando o trabalho a aplicativos e ferramentas com engenheiros de dedos, lideres de negócios. analistas e desenvolvedores.

  • Projetar recursos usando sua perspicácia nos negócios para encontrar novas formas combiner diferentes fontes de dedos internas e externas lidentificar e desenvolver processos, estrutures, ferramentas, métodos e pedrões
  • Colaborar, fornecer coaching e aprender com uma equipe crescente de cientistas de dados experientes.
  • Manter-se conectado com fontes externas de ideias por meio de conferências e projetos da comunidade
Requirements And Qualifications
O que precisamos que você tenha de conhecimento:
Requisitos essenciais:
  • Bacharelado obrigatório, Mestrado ou PhD desejável
  • Bacharelado em Ciência de Dados, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística + 5 anos de experiência requerido ou graduação em disciplina quantitativa e conjunto de habilidades de Ciência de Dados demonstrado, e'me de mais 2 anos de experiência profissional.
  • Deve ter proficiência em Python ou R trabalhando com DataFrames
  • Deve ter proficiência na criação de consultas complexas de SQL
  • Deve ter proficiência com Machine Learning para solucionar problemas de clustering, detecção de anomalias, simulação e otimização em conjuntos de dados em larga escala
  • Deve ter capacidade comprovada para fundir e transformar conjuntos de dados internos e externos distintos para criar novos recursos
  • Experiência com tecnologias de Big Data desejada - Hadoop, Spark, H2O.ai, plataformas de inteligência artificial em nuvem, conteinerização
  • Experiência no suporte à implementação, monitoramento, manutenção e mentoria dos modelos desejados
  • Experiência preferencial com ferramentas de visualização de dados - Tableau, R shiny

The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We require an HR function that thinks and acts globally. We're looking for a Senior HR Generalist to offer their expertise to our AMER region. The senior role will serve as a driver and practitioner in both regional and global HR initiatives. You will join a global team of HR professionals to provide precise, compliant and scalable HR operations to the business, advise and execute on HR issues across the whole employee life-cycle, and partner with leadership in your region. You will have an analytical approach, a keen eye for detail and the ability to interpret data trends and themes.

  • Establish a trusted partnership with the business in your region
  • Drive diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives
  • Design new policies and deliver on business-critical HR related projects globally
What we are looking for in you
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • HR experience leading initiatives across regions within a technology business
  • Regional HR experience within Latin America (Brazil and/or Mexico is a plus), with an understanding of local labor laws, competitive awareness and insights
  • Experience in business partnering with senior stakeholders
  • A good balance between leading and executing, in this role you will need to be hands-on involved in the daily HR routines
  • Experience mentoring and developing others
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to define done and keep deliverables on track
  • Experience in working in a remote first organization
  • Able to leverage data to make informed decisions
  • Fluent in business English (written and spoken)
  • Self motivated, organized, accurate, confident, authentic, results-orientated, open-minded and enthusiastic
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
Nice to have skills
  • Experience with immigration policies and mobility processes
  • Payroll and/or benefits oversight experience
  • Knowledge of HR Systems and databases
  • Professional HR certification(s)
  • Facilitation skills
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Kelley Austin takes a different approach to Salesforce Consulting by putting our employees first. That’s not hyperbole, either. Our team takes a proactive approach to employee satisfaction by having every single person fill out a “happiness list,” which comprises the top ten things each employee finds happiness in outside of work.

We review those happiness lists regularly to ensure everyone is checking most of the boxes and adjust their project load, responsibilities, or schedule accordingly if not.

Look at our benefits and perks below to learn more about our culture.

We’re growing fast (more than doubling YOY) but staying diligent in hiring the best possible people who don’t just want a job, but will actually care about the success of their co-workers and clients.

Our growth, coupled with the distinction of being recognized as the \'fastest Salesforce Implementation Partner to achieve Platinum / Summit status,\' attests to the success of our approach.

Benefits

  • Paid Holidays (including an entire week off around Christmas and New Year)

Tools We Use

  • As a technology software consulting company, we use many tools, but the big four are Google Drive, Slack, Lucid Chart, and Salesforce, of course.

Perks Of The Job

  • You won’t really find egos here. We hire slowly and purposefully to keep our culture strong and our team cohesive.

Required Technical and Professional Expertise

  • Hands-on scripting skills in Python, Shell, PowerShell, or similar .

RD Station - Pessoa Analista de Processos Pleno (BPM) Operações

Quer fazer parte de um time que cria oportunidades e potencializa a evolução?

Como alcançamos tudo isso?

Através de um time de mais de 12 mil pessoas que, juntas, oferecem soluções, produtos e educam o mercado. Formamos um ecossistema que se estende por todo o país e que ultrapassa fronteiras, integrando e conectando negócios. Sabemos que o crescimento acontece de gente para gente, e é isso que nos move.

Nosso jeito de ser:

Potencializamos a evolução: Transformamos ideias em realidade em uma empresa dinâmica e inovadora. Fazer parte deste time, significa aprender, criar e evoluir.

Bem-Estar Integral: Buscamos o bem-estar integral de cada pessoa colaboradora, por meio de ações e benefícios que promovem autocuidado através de 5 pilares: Emocional, Financeiro, Físico, Ocupacional e Social.

Pluralidade: A diversidade faz parte de quem a gente é. Reconhecidos entre as Melhores Empresas para Trabalhar no Brasil, promovemos inclusão e pertencimento de forma ativa. Nossa expertise é humana e viva, e através dela, acolhemos e empoderamos pessoas dentro e fora da empresa.

Desafio do time

Você será responsável por garantir a excelência e o sucesso das entregas dos processos associados às operações funcionais da RD. Atuará no desenvolvimento, mapeamento e (re)modelagem de processos, além de apoiar a definição e acompanhamento de indicadores para a gestão eficiente de área. Seu trabalho será fundamental para promover a melhoria contínua, aplicando metodologias ágeis e garantindo a conformidade e eficiência dos processos operacionais.

  • Mapear, desenhar e remodelar processos críticos das áreas funcionais, documentando-os em formato de playbook.
  • Construir e manter ferramentas para acompanhamento de indicadores e processos, assegurando atualização e veracidade dos dados.
  • Realizar auditorias de conformidade na execução dos processos críticos e implementar melhorias identificadas.
  • Gerar análises para identificação de gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria, criando planos de ação e acompanhando sua implementação.
  • Monitorar SLAs das áreas de operação e atuar em projetos de impacto para otimização dos processos.
  • Graduação em Administração, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em gestão de processos, com conhecimento em metodologias ágeis e BPM (incluindo BPMN).
  • Conhecimento em auditoria interna, automação de processos e cadeia de valor.
  • Capacidade analítica, senso crítico, organização e disciplina para garantir a qualidade e conformidade dos processos.
  • Boa comunicação, com foco no cliente e habilidade para trabalhar colaborativamente com diferentes áreas.

Será considerado um diferencial

  • Inglês avançado será considerado um diferencial.
  • Experiência com processos de atendimento a clientes ou logística.
  • Conhecimento em Lean e outras metodologias de melhoria contínua.
  • Vivência em ambientes de alta complexidade operacional e projetos multidisciplinares.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de automação e gestão de processos digitais.
  • Aplicação: Envie seu currículo e informações pelo nosso sistema de candidaturas.
  • Entrevista DigAi: Uma conversa inicial com nossa ferramenta de entrevista digital para conhecermos melhor seu perfil e experiências.
  • Talent Acquisition (RH): Entrevista com a equipe de Talent Acquisition para alinhamento cultural e expectativas.
  • Case e Entrevista Técnica (Coordenação): Apresentação e discussão de um case prático relacionado à posição, seguida de entrevista técnica com a coordenação do time.
  • Entrevista Final (Gerência): Conversa final com a gerência para alinhamento estratégico e decisão.
  • Oferta para pessoa candidata aprovada: Fase de conclusão do processo seletivo, com a apresentação da oferta.

Nos comprometemos com a segurança dos seus dados! Em nosso Aviso de Privacidade , descrevemos quais dados coletamos, como são consumidos e armazenados, em conformidade com a LGPD.

description:
Job description

Pure is looking for a Direct Response Copywriter to join our team! As our creative head, you will be responsible for the ideation, scripting, planning, and managing of the entire creative process with a big focus on UGC ads and psychology-based creatives to be used across paid marketing channels.

We are looking to hire someone with 3+ years of work experience. The ideal candidate has prior experience in creating paid advertisements specifically for Meta Platforms, UGC, direct response marketing & bonus points if experience with influencer / UGC partnerships.

Who are we?

At Pure , we are dedicated to transforming lives by creating high-quality supplements backed by science and trusted by our growing community. Our mission is to make achieving better health simpler, more effective, and more accessible for everyone. Since our launch, we’ve scaled rapidly through viral digital marketing and built a passionate customer base that loves and trusts our products. We operate with a small but mighty team that thrives on innovation, data-driven growth, and relentless creativity—and we’re excited to bring on a Creative Strategist to play a pivotal role in scaling our brand even further.

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values : "work smart", "overdeliver", "speed is king" and "better everyday". We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow. If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn\'t it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders- and play a huge role in scaling it to $12M+ a year. Drive results with a group of passionate, smart & hardworking fun people. Work in an environment without politics, or corporate chicanery. Play a big part in our growth being hands on, active, and doing what is necessary with an excellent bonus plan based on performance then you have come to the right place.

Key Objectives

  • Manage the full creative process (from scripting all the way to final creative) in order to produce high converting creatives on an ongoing basis.
  • Work with our content manager to find, manage and source new content to be used across all marketing channels
  • Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics across digital channels with improved creatives.
  • Script UGC Direct response creatives
  • Use data from creative performance on Meta to dissect, analyze and improve upon our creatives to continuously improve performance across our creatives.
  • Work with our marketing team to come up with new creative concepts and ideas.
  • Conduct strategic customer and competitor research to better optimize creative efforts
  • Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis
  • Decide on the next steps needed to scale Meta Ads further through better creative

Requirements

  • Fully remote
  • Fluent in English
  • Direct Response Expertise : 3+ Years Experience with performance creative for DTC brands or working at a creative agency is a must.
  • Tools & Metrics : Proficiency in performance analytics tools such as Triple Whale, Motion, pitch decks, and spreadsheets to present ideas and campaign outcomes effectively.
  • UGC Experience : Lots of experience with creating briefs for UGC creators to produce high converting content across paid channels.
  • Creative & Analytical Mindset : Ability to generate fresh ideas, write scripts, shot listing, and make data-driven decisions based on ad performance.
  • No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You wouldn\'t know what to do with your free time if you were working less. You are passionate about your work.
  • Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
  • Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders.
  • Basic psychology-based copywriting skills

Accountabilities

  • Brainstorm and pitch weekly ad ideas aligned with direct response principles.
  • Write 80-100 high-converting ad scripts per week for Meta Platforms
  • Come up with static ad ideas on a weekly basis
  • Analyze performance metrics to derive actionable insights for future campaigns.
  • Collaborate with editors and designers to ensure ads are visually compelling and on-brand.
  • Adapt ad strategies to capitalize on emerging internet trends and consumer behaviors.
  • Present performance analyses and creative strategies to the marketing team
  • Continuously refine ad concepts and troubleshoot underperforming campaigns to achieve maximum ROI.
  • Iterate on winning ads to create more winning assets to produce a better ROI.

How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

When hiring, we’ll work with you to define the KPIs you’ll be responsible for and set targets. This removes ambiguity around wondering if you’re doing a good job after you start.

Initial soft interview, then a technical interview + test project with the current head of marketing, and a final interview to ensure culture fit. We plan to hire within ~8 - 10 days of conducting these interviews. We pride ourselves on timely responses and updates for applicants.

For this specific role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business - and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed!

Salary Expectation

USD $36,000 USD to $70,000 USD per year + Performance Bonus Structure based on experience and expertise.

The Humane League (THL) is a global nonprofit ending the abuse of animals raised for food. THL fosters a high-energy culture of teamwork and mission-driven problem solving, and we have earned recognition as Top Charity from Animal Charity Evaluators for all of their rating periods. Over the past few years, we’ve grown to a staff of 100+ talented individuals dispersed across the country and around the world. At THL, how animals are treated in the food system is at the forefront of our everyday work. As such, many of our staff are vegan by personal choice, and all of our THL-hosted events offer fully vegan menus. We welcome all mission-aligned candidates to apply, no matter where you are in your journey to end the abuse of animals raised for food.
The Role
The Open Wing Alliance (OWA), a program of The Humane League, is a global coalition of approximately 90 animal protection organizations across 70+ countries united in a common goal: to end the abuse of chickens worldwide. For the past several years, we have focused our efforts on eliminating battery cages by securing cage-free policies from major retailers, restaurants, and manufacturers. OWA groups share tactics and resources to secure as many wins for animals as possible, specializing in institutional campaigning that can be tailored to our members’ unique circumstances and challenges.
As the OWA Latin America Corporate Strategy Lead, you will serve as a key subject matter expert on corporate campaigning and corporate outreach for the OWA in Latin America. You’ll be responsible for building relationships with OWA member groups and providing advice, coaching, and training in order to develop campaign knowledge and skills across the animal protection movement in the region. We want you because you are an experienced campaigner and strategic thinker with excellent interpersonal skills. You are excited about collaborating with organizations across Latin America to maximize impact for animals, and you have a deep determination to remove the worst forms of animal suffering from companies’ supply chains. This position reports to the Sr. OWA Latin America Manager.
This is a full-time, remote position. This position requires domestic and international travel, equivalent to 6-10 trips per year, and requires a valid, up-to-date passport. To enable collaboration with other global team members, you may be required to work occasional hours outside of 9am - 5pm, depending on your time zone. More details can be provided at the interview stage.
Essential Job Duties

  • Provide OWA member groups in Latin America with strategic guidance and direction for regional corporate campaign strategies, and collaborate with groups to troubleshoot issues.
  • Co-create strategies with OWA groups and serve as a coach, building their independence over time. Support groups in adapting campaign tactics to different local and regional contexts in order to secure cage-free commitments from companies.
  • Lead in-person and virtual trainings for OWA groups on corporate campaigning and corporate outreach.
  • Develop and implement personalized support plans and trainings for OWA groups.
  • Build strong relationships and trust with OWA groups, alongside a reputation as a sharp strategic thinker and strategist.
  • Develop resources and training materials in order to build resilience, empowerment, and autonomy in the OWA.
In addition to the above essential job duties, other duties may be assigned as business needs arise. These may include non-essential, marginal job duties.
Ideal Profile
  • You have previous experience with corporate pressure campaigns and/or corporate negotiations. Experience developing campaign strategy as well as carrying out specific functions related to a campaign's success
  • You have strong strategic thinking and problem solving skills, and are proactive, take initiative, and adaptable
  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills and are able to collaborate well with others
  • You are a strong networker & relationship builder

About Us

About Us :

Kelley Austin takes a different approach to Salesforce Consulting by putting our employees first. That’s not hyperbole, either. Our team takes a proactive approach to employee satisfaction by having every single person fill out a “happiness list,” which comprises the top ten things each employee finds happiness in outside of work.

Take a look at the ‘About You’ and ‘Responsibilities’ below to learn more :

Benefits

  • Base Salary

  • Paid Holidays (including an entire week off around Christmas and New Year)

Tools We Use

  • As a technology software consulting company, we use many tools, but the big four are Google Drive, Slack, Lucid Chart, and Salesforce, of course.

Perks Of The Job

  • You won’t really find egos here. We hire slowly and purposefully to keep our culture strong and our team cohesive.
  • We don’t say yes to every client and are not afraid to part ways with a client, either. If there’s no mutual respect or success involved, we politely decline and help them find a different partner. That means fewer ‘tough’ clients and more clients who “get it” and work harmoniously together.
  • We offer half a dozen different clubs like book club, health club, movie club, hobby club, and more. These bring people together to grow intellectually and get to know one another outside of project work.
  • We work an average of 40 hours per week (I know, that’s unheard of in consulting, but we stand by it).

About You

We are seeking a Data Migration Specialist with deep hands-on expertise in Salesforce, Salesforce SOQL, Salesforce APEX, relational databases, SQL, scripting, and large-scale data migration. This role is highly execution-focused and detail-oriented — you will be designing and running ETL processes, writing queries and scripts, validating data quality, and ensuring successful end-to-end migrations between enterprise systems.

Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and manage end-to-end data migration projects, including extraction, transformation, loading, and validation.
  • Write and optimize complex SQL and SOQL queries for data validation, migration, and reconciliation.
  • Build, configure, and run ETL jobs to move and transform data across Salesforce, ERP, and external databases.
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts (APEX, Python, Shell, PowerShell, or similar) for data processing, cleansing, and quality checks.
  • Perform data profiling, mapping, and transformation to meet business and technical requirements.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve migration issues such as data mismatches, performance bottlenecks, and integrity errors.
  • Collaborate with internal and external Salesforce, integration, and business teams to coordinate cutovers and validate migrated data.
  • Document migration procedures, scripts, mappings, and reconciliation steps for repeatability and compliance.
  • Ensure all migrations follow best practices for data quality, security, and governance.

Required Technical and Professional Expertise

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent hands-on experience).
  • 5+ years of direct experience in data migration, ETL, or database engineering roles.
  • Strong technical expertise in relational databases (Salesforce, Oracle, SQL Server, or similar).
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL (query optimization, joins, stored procedures).
  • Practical experience with Salesforce SOQL, APEX, and Salesforce data model.
  • Proven track record in data migration projects, including reconciliation and cutover planning.
  • Hands-on scripting skills in Python, Shell, PowerShell, or similar.
  • Familiarity with ETL tools, APIs, and bulk data processing.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is a plus.
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to deliver under tight deadlines.

description:

Aqui a gente conecta o mundo

A Sensedia é líder no mercado de APIs, oferecendo soluções de integração e consultoria a grandes empresas no Brasil e no mundo, em uma variedade de setores. Seu portfólio, além de uma plataforma API Management, inclui Sensedia Integrations, Service Mesh, API Adaptive Governance, Events Hub, Open Banking & Finance e equipes estratégicas de Professional Services.

Trabalhar aqui é pertencer a uma cultura plural, descontraída e inovadora. É para quem tem coragem de ir além, pensar e agir fora da caixa. Preferimos pedir desculpas ao invés de pedir permissão e estamos sempre dispostos a nos transformar, nos reinventar.
Nossas pessoas são incríveis e você pode fazer parte disso tudo. Nos comprometemos em garantir um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e respeitoso.

Conheça + em nosso site:


Qual a missão do Cargo?

Atuar como o parceiro estratégico e conselheiro de confiança (trusted advisor) dos nossos clientes, garantindo que eles obtenham o máximo de valor de negócio das soluções Sensedia. A missão do CSM é orquestrar a jornada do cliente de ponta a ponta, impulsionando a adoção, a satisfação e o crescimento para garantir a renovação e maximizar o Net Dollar Retention (NDR).

Quais serão suas atividades do dia-a-dia?

  • Gestão Estratégica da Carteira: Construir e manter um relacionamento profundo com os clientes, entendendo seus objetivos de negócio, KPIs e desafios para desenvolver um plano de sucesso de longo prazo.
  • Capacitação e Evangelismo: Realizar workshops técnicos, demonstrações e sessões de capacitação para as equipes do cliente, garantindo que eles tenham autonomia e conhecimento para utilizar as soluções da melhor forma.
  • Condução de Ritos de Valor: Liderar reuniões executivas de negócios (QBRs), apresentando análises de performance, o ROI alcançado e o alinhamento estratégico para o futuro.
  • Monitoramento e Ação Proativa: Monitorar continuamente a saúde da conta através de dados e métricas (Health Score, NPS, uso de produto), identificando riscos e oportunidades de forma proativa.
  • Desenhar e Apresentar Soluções: Conduzir sessões de discovery técnico com os clientes para entender seus desafios de negócio e desenhar soluções funcionais utilizando as capabilities da plataforma Sensedia.
  • Orquestração de Soluções: Atuar como a voz do cliente dentro da Sensedia, mobilizando e colaborando com os times de Produto, Suporte e Vendas para orquestrar a resolução de desafios e garantir que os esforços internos estejam alinhados às prioridades do cliente.
  • Motor de Crescimento: Identificar, qualificar e nutrir oportunidades de expansão (upsell/cross-sell), trabalhando em estreita parceria com o time de Vendas para converter essas oportunidades em novas receitas.

Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?

  • Experiência Comprovada: Experiência prévia em Customer Success, Account Management ou Gerenciamento de Contas em empresas de tecnologia (preferencialmente SaaS ou PaaS).
  • Fluência Técnica Funcional: Boa compreensão de conceitos de APIs e integrações de sistemas, conhecimento geral do design de APIs com Open API Specification / Swagger e modelos de segurança, noções básicas de arquitetura de software (microservices x monolithic), visão de Negócio e Dados: Familiaridade com as principais métricas de CS (NPS, Churn, NDR, Health Score) e capacidade de conectar soluções tecnológicas a resultados de negócio.
  • Comunicação e Didática Excepcionais: Habilidade de apresentar, negociar e se comunicar de forma clara e eficaz com diferentes públicos, do técnico ao executivo, e de conduzir workshops de capacitação.

  • Conhecimento no ecossistema Open Finance Brasil.

title: Direct Response Copywriter
description:
Overview

Pure is looking for a Direct Response Copywriter to join our team! As our creative head, you will be responsible for the ideation, scripting, planning, and managing of the entire creative process with a big focus on UGC ads and psychology-based creatives to be used across paid marketing channels.

We are looking to hire someone with 3+ years of work experience. The ideal candidate has prior experience in creating paid advertisements specifically for Meta Platforms, UGC, direct response marketing & bonus points if experience with influencer / UGC partnerships.

Who are we?

At Pure, we are dedicated to transforming lives by creating high-quality supplements backed by science and trusted by our growing community. Our mission is to make achieving better health simpler, more effective, and more accessible for everyone. Since our launch, we’ve scaled rapidly through viral digital marketing and built a passionate customer base that loves and trusts our products. We operate with a small but mighty team that thrives on innovation, data-driven growth, and relentless creativity—and we’re excited to bring on a Creative Strategist to play a pivotal role in scaling our brand even further.

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values : "work smart", "overdeliver", "speed is king" and "better everyday". We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow. If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn\u2019t it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders- and play a huge role in scaling it to $12M+ a year. Drive results with a group of passionate, smart & hardworking fun people. Work in an environment without politics, or corporate chicanery. Play a big part in our growth being hands on, active, and doing what is necessary with an excellent bonus plan based on performance then you have come to the right place.

Key Objectives

  • Manage the full creative process (from scripting all the way to final creative) in order to produce high converting creatives on an ongoing basis.
  • Work with our content manager to find, manage and source new content to be used across all marketing channels
  • Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics across digital channels with improved creatives.
  • Script UGC Direct response creatives
  • Use data from creative performance on Meta to dissect, analyze and improve upon our creatives to continuously improve performance across our creatives.
  • Work with our marketing team to come up with new creative concepts and ideas.
  • Conduct strategic customer and competitor research to better optimize creative efforts
  • Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis
  • Decide on the next steps needed to scale Meta Ads further through better creative

Requirements

  • Fully remote
  • Fluent in English
  • Direct Response Expertise: 3+ Years Experience with performance creative for DTC brands or working at a creative agency is a must.
  • Tools & Metrics: Proficiency in performance analytics tools such as Triple Whale, Motion, pitch decks, and spreadsheets to present ideas and campaign outcomes effectively.
  • UGC Experience: Lots of experience with creating briefs for UGC creators to produce high converting content across paid channels.
  • Creative & Analytical Mindset: Ability to generate fresh ideas, write scripts, shot listing, and make data-driven decisions based on ad performance.
  • No issue working overtime or on weekends if needed. You wouldn\u2019t know what to do with your free time if you were working less. You are passionate about your work.
  • Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
  • Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders.
  • Basic psychology-based copywriting skills

Accountabilities

  • Brainstorm and pitch weekly ad ideas aligned with direct response principles.
  • Write 80-100 high-converting ad scripts per week for Meta Platforms
  • Come up with static ad ideas on a weekly basis
  • Analyze performance metrics to derive actionable insights for future campaigns.
  • Collaborate with editors and designers to ensure ads are visually compelling and on-brand.
  • Adapt ad strategies to capitalize on emerging internet trends and consumer behaviors.
  • Present performance analyses and creative strategies to the marketing team
  • Continuously refine ad concepts and troubleshoot underperforming campaigns to achieve maximum ROI.
  • Iterate on winning ads to create more winning assets to produce a better ROI.

How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

When hiring, we’ll work with you to define the KPIs you’ll be responsible for and set targets. This removes ambiguity around wondering if you’re doing a good job after you start.

Initial soft interview, then a technical interview + test project with the current head of marketing, and a final interview to ensure culture fit. We plan to hire within ~8 - 10 days of conducting these interviews. We pride ourselves on timely responses and updates for applicants.

For this specific role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business - and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed!

Salary Expectation

USD $36,000 USD to $70,000 USD per year + Performance Bonus Structure based on experience and expertise.

title: Global Payroll Accountant
description:
Overview

Payroll is one of the most critical and visible processes for our global team at Camunda. As Global Payroll Accountant, you’ll be at the center of our efforts to deliver accurate, timely, and compliant payroll across multiple countries and vendors. You’ll help stabilize and scale our payroll operations, work with modern HR and finance tools, and collaborate with HR, Accounting, and external partners. Your impact ensures our employees always get paid correctly and on time while supporting process improvements and automation projects. This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on exposure to multi-country payroll and be a trusted contributor in a Finance team that lives our FAITH values: Focus, Ambition, Integrity, Talent, and Humor.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Process payroll for multiple entities (such as US, DE, UK, SG, and PEO countries), ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely delivery.
  • Partner with HR, Accounting, and external payroll vendors to gather, review, and validate payroll data (salaries, benefits, deductions, new hires, terminations).
  • Support payroll reconciliations (clearing accounts, accruals, P&L) and prepare documentation for audits and internal controls.
  • Identify and support opportunities for process improvements and automation to streamline payroll operations.
  • Respond to employee questions on payroll, guiding them with clarity and empathy.

What You Bring

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product.
  • Proven experience in multi-entity/global payroll processing, including coordination with third-party payroll vendors.
  • Meticulous attention to detail and a track record of delivering accurate results under tight deadlines.
  • High integrity and discretion in handling sensitive payroll and employee data.
  • Ownership mentality – takes initiative, drives tasks to completion, and demonstrates accountability.
  • Adaptability and strong cross-functional collaboration skills with HR, Accounting, Finance, and vendors.
  • Commitment to compliance and process excellence, ensuring accuracy while seeking improvements.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with US payroll (Gusto) and familiarity with international payroll portals.
  • Hands-on exposure to systems like NetSuite, FloQast, or HRIS (Bob).
  • Prior involvement in payroll system upgrades or automation projects.
  • Knowledge of benefit accounting or commission plans.

Compensation

What We Have to Offer: We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition. The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:

  • United States: $90,900.00 to $149,900.00
  • Germany: €58,700.00 to €97,100.00
  • United Kingdom: £57,100.00 to £93,800.00
  • Singapore: S$112,800.00 to S$169,200

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.
  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.
  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and an annual fitness reimbursement.
  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.
  • Professional Growth: Up to $1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!
  • More of what we offer globally & in your country can be found here.

We help over 75,000 real people every month take control of their health with clean, powerful supplements—no fillers, no fakes, no celebrity nonsense.

We’ve built one of the most transparent supplement companies in the world—zero fillers, no gimmicks, and absolutely no pharma ties. Just real ingredients, real results, and over 33,000 verified reviews backing it up.

Now we’re building the most effective marketing team in the industry—starting with you.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We’re hiring a Meta Ads Manager who can take full control of our Facebook and Instagram ad channels—replacing agency and outperforming them in 60 days.

This role is yours to own. You’ll run it, scale it, and build a machine around it.

We want someone who’s driven by mission, not just money.

If you want to be just another media buyer, this isn’t for you.

If you want to help people, move fast, and finally work on something real—you’ll thrive here.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Take over our Meta ad account (currently spending £400K/month)
  • Come up with 95% of the ad angles, hooks, and campaigns (Founder will send you some things to turn into ads)
  • Build and test landing pages that actually convert
  • Use our 33K+ reviews, customer stories, and product results to fuel your creative
  • Turn the founder’s raw ideas, notes, or videos into full ads (when provided)
  • Build your own lean team as needed (e.g., video editor, outsourced image creation, etc.) — but only when it’s worth the money. We run lean, cut dead wood fast, and only hire when absolutely necessary so you should have the skills to start doing the above and then hire.
  • Hit and maintain ROAS targets unless testing a branding initiative
  • Ask for what you need—tools, creators, budget. You’ll have our backing most of the time.

WHAT YOU WON’T DO

  • You won’t wait for us to tell you what to test
  • You won’t be buried in meetings
  • You won’t be forced to work on fake, low-quality products
  • You won’t be chasing bonuses—we expect high performance as standard
  • You won’t be treated like a cog in a machine

WHO YOU ARE

  • You’ve scaled Meta ad accounts spending £100K+/month and know what you’re doing
  • You think like a direct-response marketer and live inside customer psychology
  • You know how to write or brief scroll-stopping ads
  • You’re not afraid to take ownership and lead
  • Most of all—you want to build something real that helps people

COMPENSATION

  • Compensation based on experience – we’re open to finding the right fit. We pay well, but we don’t pay for fluff. If you’ve got the skills, we’ll make it work
  • Full-time and fully remote (some in-person meetings if nearby)
  • 28 days paid annual leave
  • No performance bonus—we don’t bribe people to care.
  • Long-term loyalty and impact will be rewarded in more meaningful ways

WHY THIS MATTERS

If you knock this out of the park, we’ll give you more. More traffic sources. More responsibility. More opportunity.

Our long-term goal is to scale to £10 million/month in ad spend—across Meta, Google, TikTok, Reddit, X, direct mail, and more. That’s the level we’re building for.

There are some manufacturing constraints we need to solve first, but once we do, we’ll need leaders who can handle massive growth.

Show us you’re the one—and you’ll grow with us.

You’ll be replacing a bloated agency that’s spending big and underdelivering.

You’ll be part of a team that tells the truth, helps people feel better, and fights back against the garbage being pushed by Big Pharma and mainstream wellness brands.

If that excites you—you might be one of us.

Overview

UNICEF works in over 190 countries and territories to save children’s lives, defend their rights, and help them fulfill their potential, from early childhood through adolescence.

At UNICEF, we are committed, passionate, and proud of what we do for as long as we are needed. Promoting the rights of every child is not just a job – it is a calling.

Visit our website to learn more about what we do at UNICEF.

For every child, peace

UNICEF Mexico is preparing the Country Programme Management Plan (CPMP). The CPMP is a strategic planning document that describes the main management structure and mechanisms to support the implementation of the Country Programme (CPD) and the achievement of its proposed results. The integrated budget (IB) is an integral part of the CPMP preparation process and consolidates plans for the utilization of all available resources available to the Country Office, linking them to its programmes, their effectiveness, and management results.

When preparing the CPMP, the Office must ensure that the UNICEF-supported Country Programme is accompanied by a management strategy, organizational structure, and an adequate budget to achieve the expected results.

How can you make a difference?

Under the supervision of the Deputy Representative Operations, guidance from the Representative and collaboration with the Deputy Representative Programme and all staff, this consultancy must directly contribute to the development of the CPMP for the Mexico Office and all its components.

Prepare the CPMP and its accompanying documents to support the implementation of the new Cooperation Programme Document (CPD), in accordance with the latest UNICEF guidelines and ensuring participation of all staff.

Develop the organizational structure of UNICEF Mexico in line with the new CPD and following Division of People & Culture (DPC) guidance.

Facilitate virtual meetings with the various areas of UNICEF Mexico to discuss and formulate the CPMP, ensuring transparency and staff participation.

Main Activities

  1. Review of key documentation:
  • CPMP template
  • Office Risk Management Plan
  • Strategic Notes for program areas
  • Outputs from the programme area process and workload consultancy
  • Cooperation Programme Document (CPD) and annexes
  • United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework (UNSDCF) document and annexes )
  • Country Common Assessment (CCA) and UNSDCF evaluation reports )
  • UNSDCF evaluation report )
  • Considerations and main findings of the Situation Analysis (SITAN) of UNICEF Mexico
  • Reimagine UNICEF Initiatives
  • United Nations Reform Process
  • Critically consolidate all suggestions and comments and prepare a quality CPMP (in line with the formal requirements for the document we have in UNICEF) in close consultation with UNICEF Mexico senior management.

    • Deliverables

    • Consultation meetings are held with the various areas necessary for the development of the CPMP document. Sessions are planned to be online with at least the following areas: Senior Management, Programme, Operations, Communication, PFP
    • CPMP document, identifying the main aspects in the following areas: a) Programme Management Environment and lessons learned from the previous period and b) Management and Results Strategy.
    • Organizational structure of UNICEF Mexico (staff and non-staff).
    • Annexes

    *Each product must be delivered to UNICEF; it will be considered a final version after UNICEF's approval.

title: Regional Contract Manager-LAM
description:
Join to apply for the Regional Contract Manager-LAM role at GE Vernova

Job Description Summary

Contract negotiation and compliance with contract commitments and commercial risk assessment & management of risk processes in the commercial (ITO - Inquiry-to-Order and OTR - Order To Remittance) phase. Overall engagement with the proposal generation process and commercial negotiations, to ensure commercial intensity & compliance to the Grid Solutions Deal Risk Management process (Policy 5.0). This role drives commercial operations and risk management initiatives at ITO and OTR stages, improves rigor in deal making/closure, and supports operation excellence to ensure proper risk management throughout the deal lifecycle, while closely aligning to customer CTQs. Also, to provide systematic & efficient analysis of contracts for maximizing financial and operational performance & minimizing risk with proper mitigations.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Review and redline customer terms and conditions (T&Cs) and other commercial & contractual documents.
  • Ensure an acceptable risk profile for GE given the specific scope of supply and deal dynamics.
  • Lead and finalize the contractual schemes and industrial models while engaging with all respective stakeholders (Tax, Legal, Commercial Finance, Controllers, Operations, EHS).
  • Identify & register identified risks in Risk Assessment Matrix tool and Salesforce, build & operate Risk Review sessions to drive early engagement, strategy development & approvals ensuring leadership alignment.
  • Own the ComOps and respective risk process, including the use of tools and governance instances, ensuring development of consistent operations in ITO, adherent to policies, processes & metrics and ensuring application of agreed actions.
  • Draft, discuss & negotiate NDA, Consortium Agreements, declaration forms etc. with potential partners.
  • Develop commercial expertise across regional Commercial & Sales teams, to ensure implementation of Grid risk policies & standardized best practices.
  • Support ITO teams by applying KPIs and challenging risk/opportunity assessments & propose mitigation strategies.
  • Partner with the Region Sales teams in strategy development to create winning proposals and meet or exceed the region’s plan for orders and financial KPIs.
  • Support and drive change management to improve commercial processes, reduce cycle times & costs, and improve service quality.
  • Support large and complex projects from inquiry to close-out.
  • Support projects from execution start-up with contract analyses and flow-down requirements for project subcontractors.
  • Establish and implement project-specific contractual procedures, particularly regarding claims, insurance, variation orders, correspondence and notifications.
  • Support project risk and opportunity identification and analysis.
  • Provide support and guidance to the project team on general contractual issues and claims, clarifying contractual/legal enquiries as necessary with Legal.
  • Provide support in the event of a (potential) dispute.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Legal, Engineering, or related area from an accredited university or college.
  • Minimum of 10 - 15 years of experience in Commercial Operations, Contract Management, Sales, Risk Mitigation, Tendering, Bid management and/or project management role.
  • Fluent in English; French & Arabic languages are an advantage.
  • Working remotely from the same region can be considered.

Desired Characteristics

  • Strong contractual & negotiation skills.
  • Strong oral and written communication & presentation skills.
  • Knowledge of electrical transmission or power projects.
  • Strong interpersonal and leadership skills with Lean Adaptability.
  • Self-sufficiency & ability to influence and lead cross-functional teams.
  • Experience in developing complex proposals or structuring complex deals.
  • In-depth knowledge of contractual terms and conditions, risk management; experience in structuring and negotiating contracts to minimize business risk.
  • Ability to think strategically and be operationally rigorous.
  • Familiarity with the use and function of CRMs (Salesforce).
  • Independence in achieving commercial objectives within operating budgets and guidelines.

Additional Information

  • This is a remote position
